relevant_laws.quote: The City Traffic Engineer shall determine upon what streets angle parking shall be permitted, and shall provide signage or other markings to indicate where such parking is permitted. Where angle parking is permitted, no person shall stand or park a vehicle unless the front of the vehicle is pointed toward the direction of lawful traffic movement.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct standing/parking vehicle-front orientation duty where Engineer-permitted angle parking is marked
relevant_laws.notes: Exact witness selects permitted angle-parking orientation.
